description: Provision a Google Cloud Identityplatform IdentityPlatformTenant via Config Connector. Fields mirror the identityplatform.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 IdentityPlatformTenant spec.

allowPasswordSignup.description: Whether to allow email/password user authentication.

disableAuth.description: Whether authentication is disabled for the tenant. If true, the users under the disabled tenant are not allowed to sign-in. Admins of the disabled tenant are not able to manage its users.

enableAnonymousUser.description: Whether to enable anonymous user authentication.

enableEmailLinkSignin.description: Whether to enable email link user authentication.

mfaConfig.description: The tenant-level configuration of MFA options.

enabledProviders.description: A list of usable second factors for this project.

state.description: Whether MultiFactor Authentication has been enabled for this project. Possible values: STATE_UNSPECIFIED, DISABLED, ENABLED, MANDATORY

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The service-generated name of the resource. Used for acquisition only. Leave unset to create a new resource.

testPhoneNumbers.description: A map of <test phone number, fake code> pairs that can be used for MFA. The phone number should be in E.164 format (https://www.itu.int/rec/T-REC-E.164/) and a maximum of 10 pairs can be added (error will be thrown once exceeded).
